description: Coleta Resíduos Sólidos Urbanos is a dataset listed in City of São Paulo open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). Os valores apresentados nas planilhas referem-se ao total (geral e por tipo de resíduo), por mês e ano, em toneladas, de resíduos sólidos coletados pelas empresas e concessionárias do serviço público participantes do Sistema de Limpeza Urbana da cidade de São Paulo. Coverage: São Paulo. The portal files it under the publisher AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). Its tags are Resíduos Sólidos, resíduos, resíduos coletados. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2021-03-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-spcity-portal.
